verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing control over personal data. WHOIS contact data is redacted from public output by default, and users can edit the stored WHOIS contact record, but Cloudflare says it still stores the authentic WHOIS record. Letting a domain lapse by disabling auto-renew is about the registration, not about deleting data. missing for 10: documented data-retention periods or policies, user-initiated deletion of stored WHOIS/account data, data export or erasure controls, API or agent-accessible retention controls, independent corroboration.
